Hi Elena / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great discussion and really excited to partner on this POC. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off: 

High-level success criteria (please confirm):
- Achieve 99th percentile inference latency <= 250ms for our 1k token baseline prompts under a simulated 20RPM workload
- End-to-end throughput target: sustain 50 concurrent sessions with <= 500ms median latency
- Matching/worse-case parity in generated output quality compared to your current baseline (we'll run n=500 prompt evals using your prompt set)
- All data used in the trial is handled per your compliance needs (see VPC option below)

Evaluation plan / timeline (target ~3-week POC):
1) Week 0 (this week): finalize environment choice and accounts, agree on test prompts and dataset, sign minimal trial terms
2) Week 1: provision environment and run baseline smoke tests (latency, cold-start metrics, KV cache behavior)
3) Week 2: full load tests, prompt set evals, quality review with your PMs
4) Week 3: follow-up review, decision on next steps (scale to Dedicated/Prod or iterate)

Environment options (pro/cons):
- Hosted Redwood sandbox (fastest): we spin up isolated model endpoints in our hosted environment. Pros: fastest to start (<24-48h), lower friction. Cons: shared control plane (data access controls available), not ideal for strict network isolation requirements.
- Dedicated sandbox (recommended for throughput-focused tests): reserved GPU pool for FinPath in our Dedicated environment. Pros: predictable throughput and repeatable perf, minimal noisy neighbors. Cons: provisioning lead time (1-3 business days after sign-off).
- VPC trial (best for compliance): private control plane with customer-managed networking (peering / VPC/VPN). Pros: data never leaves your VPC, ideal for regulated data. Cons: longer setup (3-7 business days depending on network approvals).

Recommendation: If compliance is not blocking, start with Hosted sandbox for an initial smoke + quality pass (fastest), then move to Dedicated sandbox to validate throughput and production-like latency. If FinPath requires strict isolation from day 1, we should plan a VPC trial and adjust the timeline accordingly.

Ownership / asks:
- Redwood: Marissa (program lead) — overall timeline and commercial; Connor (SE) — environment provisioning, test plan, and runbooks
- FinPath: Elena (PM) — success criteria & prompt set; Rajiv (Infra) — AWS account, VPC peering details, firewall/IP allowlist

Immediate next steps:
1) Please confirm the success criteria above and which environment you want to start with (Hosted / Dedicated / VPC).
2) If VPC or Dedicated: provide AWS account ID and point-of-contact for network work.
3) Confirm availability for a 30–45m kickoff tomorrow or Wednesday — I propose Wed Jul 22 at 10:00am PT; Connor will lead the technical portion.

I've attached our POC checklist and the network requirements spreadsheet to help accelerate the setup.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
